transformation.method: Lexical character scanner removes only ASCII space, tab, CR and LF outside JSON strings, then writes one final LF.

historical_identity_contract.restore_original: Read the entire recorded path at preformat_fixed_commit, or fetch the exact original.sha Git blob; check original.bytes and original.sha256 before an old whole-hash reader.
historical_identity_contract.internal_manifest_bytes_and_SHA_fields: Copied token-for-token. They remain historical descriptions of their originally declared objects; they are not silently reinterpreted as the new formatted file identity.
historical_identity_contract.current_whole_identity: Use the current record for this formatted path. The field sha in original/current records denotes its actual Git SHA-1 blob; sha256 denotes SHA-256 of the entire UTF-8 body.
historical_identity_contract.reader_handling: Ordinary JSON readers get identical ordered content. A reader that expects old whole bytes must restore the exact old body first, never alias current text with the old hash.
historical_identity_contract.canonical_source_parameter_input_contrac: No source, binding runtime, ready, queue, request, CLI input, proof, raw report or checkpoint file is modified. This package acts only on the selected delivery metadata files; their embedded complete source/parameter/failure/unknown records remain token-identical.

publication_contract.if_current_differs: Do not overwrite or discard newer evidence; omit that path and rebase the mapping on its complete new original.
